purpose: Only reproduced, verified, version-bound operational repairs belong here. No credentials, business records, commands from provider logs, or grants of authority.

observations.cause: FCOS run 43031230905 spent 424 seconds in Playwright system dependency installation and failed to resolve the Ubuntu archive before any stage provider operation.
observations.correction: Install the pinned Chromium build and verify a headless desktop render with the runner libraries. Install system dependencies once only when readiness fails. Qualify the same installer on the hosted runner before activation.
observations.prevention: Bound the credential-free readiness step, reuse the original quality artifact for a failed pre-deployment staging job and keep authenticated smoke mandatory.

observations.cause: Direct reminder fixtures omitted the request scope now required on hosted workers.
observations.correction: Model canonical cron request in fixtures; retain fail-closed unscoped worker.
observations.prevention: Request-scope regression fixtures

observations.cause: Pinned Vercel adapter default output references source files outside uploaded output.
observations.correction: Build standalone and reject external or traversal filePathMap references before credentials.
observations.prevention: Artifact confinement regression test

observations.cause: A failed post-prerequisite smoke could be skipped when prerequisite success was reused.
observations.correction: Persist prerequisite and affected smoke checkpoints independently.
observations.prevention: Resume test checks exactly one prerequisite write and one promotion

observations.cause: A new application branch was compared to old main and inherited already-published Salesforce history.
observations.correction: Check unpublished commits against fresh exact-remote heads, preserving conservative mirror gates for real or uncertain Salesforce changes.
observations.prevention: Fresh-remote/reversion/merge/spoofed-ref regression cases

observations.cause: Public build settings initialized runtime clients in SSR unit fixtures and retained open work.
observations.correction: Provide public runtime settings only to the build and pinned contract check; keep unit commands isolated.
observations.prevention: Credential-free command environment and full clean-build qualification

observations.cause: Broad changes selected normal-role checks but could leave only two baseline modules selected.
observations.correction: Bind actual literal candidate module inventory, broaden all affected modules, and require real read/desktop/path evidence.
observations.prevention: Unknown modules and moved paths fail closed

observations.cause: Binding the controller to current main HEAD forced unrelated application commits to requalify it.
observations.correction: Use the qualified frozen checkout and hash-bound complete handover plan, with native workflow-blob admission before credentials.
observations.prevention: Forged source under old plan, changed workflow and failed qualification tests

observations.cause: Continuing controller admission depended on old Actions run and review histories that can expire.
observations.correction: Retain the observed review in an owner-created Deployment and finalized private receipt; recheck the current private fence before provider writes.
observations.prevention: Expired-history, bot-copy, latest-receipt, unknown-write and disabled-guard regression cases

observations.cause: The offline historical wrapper denied reviewed local archive creation and extraction while preserving provider refusal.
observations.correction: Derive the complete bounded zip create and unzip list/extract contract from the unchanged archive validator; allow only exact private fixture paths and expected JSON member.

verification.command: node --import tests/helpers/runtimeCompatibilityHistoricalNoProviders.mjs --test-reporter=tap --test-name-pattern="real GitHub seconds timestamps" tests/runtimeCompatibilitySuccessorLive.historical.mjs (exact retained offline harness)

observations.prevention: Source-derived local archive regression plus unchanged actual case13; no executable automatic repair recipe.

observations.cause: Staging request restrictions did not guard Salesforce and Google refresh-token grants.
observations.correction: Reject both durable refresh grants inside the provider helpers before their first provider call.
observations.prevention: Focused zero-call regression for each provider; nonrotating Salesforce JWT authentication stays separately governed.

observations.cause: Initial handover workflow selected the credentialed controller checkout directly from plan input.
observations.correction: Verify installed protected-main ancestry, exact plan hash, native source quality and both frozen workflow blobs before checkout.
observations.prevention: Changed workflow, failed quality and divergent source cannot emit an admitted checkout SHA.

observations.cause: Native Linux quality exposed a Mac checkout-name assertion and a v2 fixture that assumed executing configuration could never advance.
observations.correction: Compare the real module-derived controller root; retain the exact v2 current config in a one-object non-thin carrier while verifying the actual v3 current source separately.

repairTime.measurement: Wall elapsed since local native-failure log capture, through focused verification

observations.prevention: Run the cheap fixture preflight before publishing another controller; all historical manifests, source bindings and original complete case body remain unchanged.

observations.cause: A new controller Preview branch lacked the three canonical public FCUNO federation build settings. The original build terminated before browser verification.
observations.correction: Verify source-derived branch-only plain Preview values before one separately journaled replacement of the known terminal failed build. Preserve both deployment identities and the original frozen controller.
observations.prevention: Exact public configuration preflight; no private Production configuration copying, discarded failures, or blind provider retries.

observations.cause: GitHub variable inventory returned only30 of32 rows even with per_page=100. An initial-only completeness check correctly stopped but ran after expensive native bootstrap readback.
observations.correction: Read complete30-item pages with stable total, unique names and exact full count; perform that preflight before opening the five-minute database lease. Keep original setup and uncertainty fences.

preconditions.scope: Initial metadata-reader setup; GitHub repository and environment variable inventories

observations.prevention: Pagination regressions cover truncated, duplicate, changing-total and activation-present inventories; configuration metadata preflights precede private reads and writes.

observations.cause: The prior controller Preview token returned INVALID_SESSION_ID; an earlier legacy-slot update had an unknown acknowledgement.
observations.correction: Preserve the unknown legacy request and use a distinct branch-scoped sensitive token key, preferred only inside governed read-only requests.
observations.prevention: Dedicated read-only preference tests preserve JWT-first canonical behavior and durable refresh refusal; sanitized native HTTP observations precede acknowledgements.

observations.cause: The handover quiescence check found an authenticated-release run waiting since 23 October, after costly bootstrap admission.
observations.correction: Verify the exact old restricted job has no executed steps, journal its cancellation intent, cancel only that stale waiting run, and read back its terminal state.
observations.prevention: Check exact overlapping workflow liveness before private setup and preserve active-write/unknown-operation fences; cancellation is not an automatic repair recipe.

observations.cause: An external plan helper used locale-ordered release canonicalization for the native handover plan; nested controlPreimage/controllerSha keys produce a different digest.
observations.correction: Use the source-owned handoverDigest for handover plans and keep existing manifest/bootstrap/successor digest domains unchanged.
observations.prevention: Cross-domain regression rejects a locale digest while accepting the actual source-owned native handover digest before dispatch.

observations.cause: The original setup held one five-minute managed database lease across staging waits and lacked recovery from final receipt success before activation. A merged installation also needed a separately bound replacement PR.
observations.correction: Close source-owned database contexts before waits, open a fresh native context at each checkpoint, recover activation only from the exact locked private and owner GitHub final receipts, and bind replacement PR identity without changing old plan bytes.

repairTime.measurement: Wall elapsed from sanitized exact handover refusal capture through integrated affected tests

observations.prevention: Real native-role lifecycle fixtures, actual bootstrap guard plus final receipt recovery, strict unknown acknowledgement tests, precredential stale workflow gate, and unchanged historical PR plan golden hashes.

observations.cause: Protected Cashflow Forecast reads repeatedly stopped staging. A prior governed run reproduced a 20.004-second transport timeout. The Nomination native failure code did not expose the transport subtype, and the same staged read later returned valid rows in 16.905 seconds.
observations.correction: Permit one identical bounded Cashflow Forecast read only if the first request times out before a response. Retain the original deadline per request, both authenticated roles, payload validation and mutation denial.
observations.prevention: The native runner can recover a matching fetch timeout in the same job. The second timeout and any received HTTP or payload failure remain terminal. The new controller must qualify before activation.

observations.cause: Salesforce CLI 2.145.6 places metadata directory contents under zip/. The original command declared single-package mode, and Salesforce rejected the bootstrap because package.xml was outside the expected root.
observations.correction: Use directory package mode for the verified metadata directory. Keep exact manifest coverage, converted-byte verification, test levels and provider identity checks.
observations.prevention: Check both generated command modes in release qualification and exercise the exact native package transport with check-only DEVEE validation when the transport changes.

observations.cause: A successful Salesforce schema bootstrap reported its package.xml descriptor with a blank component type. The readback also rejected an exact native field because the false-default allowance assumed the reviewed source omitted that value.
observations.correction: Recognize only the native successful package.xml descriptor and accept exact field bytes before checking serialization allowances. Recover the original DEVEE bootstrap through linked native receipts, exact converted package, terminal provider report, and current inventory.
observations.prevention: Rehearse exact provider result formats and test retained original job adoption with failed receipt, package, and inventory bindings.
